title: IT Program Manager
summary: An IT program manager runs a group of related IT projects, such as a core system replacement or a cloud move, as one program. They own the program plan, budget, vendors and governance (the steering committee where sponsors take decisions), with project managers reporting to them.
dailyDuties: Review the integrated plan, dependencies and RAID log with project managers
Track program spend against budget and update the forecast
Prepare and run steering committee meetings with sponsors
Review change requests and their business case
Hold vendors and system integrators to their statements of work
Write executive status reports for the CIO and business heads

skills.expectation: Run a program of related IT projects with an integrated plan, dependencies and RAID logs
Set up program governance, chair steering committees and track benefits
Own the program budget, forecast spend and explain variances
Build and refresh business cases and cost-benefit analysis for change requests
Manage system integrators and vendors against statements of work
Hold project managers to scope, schedule and plan
Run programs that mix agile and waterfall projects
Align business sponsors, IT leaders and vendors on scope and priorities
Write executive status reports and steering committee packs
Run PI planning on SAFe programs
Lead data centre or cloud migration programs
Lead project managers and a program office team
Negotiate vendor contracts and change requests
Build clear decks for leadership reviews

certifications.why: Most-asked credential in India program manager postings
Named as an alternative to PMP, especially at European banks
Helps on SAFe programs; the SAFe program-level certs are not in our list yet
